usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all SDN route maps visible to the authenticated user. Results are filtered by permission — only route maps where the caller holds SDN.Audit or SDN.Allocate on the cluster are returned. Pass `running: true` to retrieve the currently active (applied) configuration rather than the pending/configured state.

examples.summary: List all pending SDN route maps
List only the running (applied) SDN route maps

tips: Without the `running` flag, the response reflects the saved configuration which may differ from what is currently active if `pvesh set /cluster/sdn/reload` has not been run.
Each returned object contains only the `id` field; use a per-route-map GET to retrieve full configuration details.
SDN must be enabled in the cluster (Datacenter > SDN) before route maps appear; an empty array is the normal response on clusters that have never configured SDN routing.
